operator_checklist.prompt: Confirm every object named in required_features is present and visible in DipTrace before the source export.
Confirm the unchanged control objects are present in the same design.
Open the captured source in DipTrace, save it under a new filename, and do not make an intentional design edit.
Export fresh XML from the saved design under a third filename.
Record any unexpected visible change in the operator note.

purpose: Collect a source/open-save/re-export triple for one explicitly documented format question.
required_features: Replace this line with the exact object/setting combination under investigation.
Include at least one unchanged control object selected by the experiment author.
title: PCB format question evidence capture
